description: This file defines an interface IStreamQueueMapper for mapping streams to queues in Orleans streaming infrastructure. It includes methods to retrieve all queues and to get the queue for a specific stream.

classes.name: IStreamQueueMapper
classes.description: Interface responsible for mapping streams to queues and retrieving all queues, ensuring thread safety.

methods.name: GetAllQueues
methods.description: Returns an enumerable collection of all QueueId instances representing all queues.

methods.name: GetQueueForStream
methods.description: Returns the QueueId responsible for the specified StreamId.
